en: Montana Messenger carries only what it shows: the code of features the Messenger does not have is no longer part of the app, and it no longer lists or offers to open other apps.
ru: Montana Messenger несёт только то, что показывает: кода функций, которых в Мессенджере нет, в приложении больше нет, и оно больше не перечисляет другие приложения и не предлагает их открыть.
zh-Hans: Montana Messenger 只包含它所展示的内容：Messenger 没有的功能，其代码已不再随应用提供；应用也不再列出或提议打开其他应用。

en: No change to any algorithm, key or network road. The coin, Money Flow and wallet code stands under #if !MONTANA_MESSENGER and is not compiled into the Messenger (cut C6); Code/Messenger/Info.plist no longer declares LSApplicationQueriesSchemes, so the Messenger queries no other app's URL scheme (R-7); its own URL scheme stays. tools/mt-names-check.py holds the plist; tools/mt-red-word-check.py holds the carriage: a Messenger letter ends at 30 days, the Protocol's coin letter rides to its receipt.
